# VR-3: Is Relay Bias Graded, and MeApd-Restricted?

## Overview

Two questions share machinery here. First: is the WildR-UP bias along the olfactory–amygdalar chemosensory relay **graded** by chain position (feed-forward from a chemosensory entry) or **flat** (parallel / diffusible)? Second: within MeA, does signal concentrate in the **posterodorsal** (sexually dimorphic, AOB-recipient) subdivision? Position 3G is excluded from ordinal models. Effect sizes with CIs are primary; n = 6 animals.

```{r}

}
```

## Background

An 80% WildR-UP bias at the relay is compatible with either feed-forward propagation or tissue-wide parallel modulation. These predict different intervention points. Separately, a male-specific phenotype linked to accessory-olfactory anatomy predicts MeApd enrichment; uniform MeA distribution severs that dimorphism link even if the relay story survives.

## Next Steps

- **Done:** specified ordinal gradient with mandatory detection covariates, Wilson node fractions, hippocampal carry-over audit for `0076`, and within-section MeApd/MeApv tests.
- Run after VR-1 licenses a claim worth localising.
- Monotone adjusted gradient → intervene at the earliest node; flat adjusted profile → diffusible / astrocyte–metabolite hypothesis.

```{r}
#| label: setup

suppressPackageStartupMessages({

  library(ggplot2)
})
source(file.path(wkdir, "notebooks/R_scripts/vr_relay_helpers.R"))
paths <- vr_paths(wkdir)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-chain
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

mast <- load_mast_hits(paths = paths) %>%
  filter(tissue == "AMY", !excluded_gene)

chain_map <- mast %>%
  distinct(supertype_name, cell_type) %>%
  mutate(chain_position = assign_chain_position(supertype_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chain_position)) %>%
  arrange(chain_position, supertype_name)

write_csv(chain_map, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR3_chain_map.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-grad
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

# Focal genes: ≥3 amygdalar hits in positions 1–4
relay_hits <- mast %>%
  filter(chain_position %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4")) %>%
  mutate(pos = as.integer(chain_position))

focal <- relay_hits %>%
  count(gene, name = "n_hits") %>%
  filter(n_hits >= 3) %>%
  pull(gene)

# Per-supertype detection covariates from dspin sample_meta / cells_meta
cov_path <- file.path(tbl_dir, "VR3_supertype_covariates.csv")
build_cov <- function() {
  units <- list.files(paths$dspin, pattern = "^AMY__", full.names = TRUE)
  bind_rows(lapply(units, function(u) {
    sm <- file.path(u, "sample_meta.csv")
    cm <- file.path(u, "cells_meta.csv")
    if (!file.exists(sm)) return(NULL)
    meta <- read_csv(sm, show_col_types = FALSE)
    lab <- sub("^AMY__", "", basename(u))
    # median UMI if present in cells_meta
    med_umi <- NA_real_
    if (file.exists(cm)) {
      cells <- read_csv(cm, show_col_types = FALSE)
      # try common umi columns
      ucol <- intersect(c("nCount_RNA", "n_counts", "umi", "total_counts"), names(cells))[1]
      if (!is.na(ucol)) med_umi <- median(cells[[ucol]], na.rm = TRUE)
      st_name <- cells$supertype_name[1]
    } else {
      st_name <- NA_character_
    }
    tibble(
      supertype_label = lab,
      supertype_name = st_name,
      n_cells = sum(meta$n_cells, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_UMI = med_umi,
      chain_position = assign_chain_position(st_name)
    )
  }))
}
cov <- build_cov()
write_csv(cov, cov_path)

cov2 <- cov %>%
  filter(chain_position %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4")) %>%
  mutate(pos = as.integer(chain_position), log_n = log1p(n_cells))

# Detection-power control: corr(median UMI, position)
umi_pos <- cov2 %>% filter(is.finite(median_UMI), is.finite(pos))
rho_umi <- if (nrow(umi_pos) >= 4) {
  suppressWarnings(cor(umi_pos$median_UMI, umi_pos$pos, method = "spearman"))
} else NA_real_

grad_rows <- lapply(focal, function(g) {
  df <- relay_hits %>%
    filter(gene == g) %>%
    transmute(supertype_name, pos, coef, gene) %>%
    left_join(
      cov2 %>% select(supertype_name, median_UMI, log_n, n_cells),
      by = "supertype_name"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(coef), is.finite(pos))
  if (nrow(df) < 3) return(NULL)
  fit_u <- lm(coef ~ pos, data = df)
  fit_a <- tryCatch(
    lm(coef ~ pos + median_UMI + log_n, data = df %>% filter(is.finite(median_UMI))),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  ci_u <- suppressWarnings(confint(fit_u))
  if (is.null(fit_a) || nrow(df %>% filter(is.finite(median_UMI))) < 4) {
    slope_a <- ci_a_lo <- ci_a_hi <- NA_real_
  } else {
    ci_a <- suppressWarnings(confint(fit_a))
    slope_a <- unname(coef(fit_a)[["pos"]])
    ci_a_lo <- unname(ci_a["pos", 1])
    ci_a_hi <- unname(ci_a["pos", 2])
  }
  tibble(
    gene = g,
    n_hits = nrow(df),
    slope = unname(coef(fit_u)[["pos"]]),
    ci_low = unname(ci_u["pos", 1]),
    ci_high = unname(ci_u["pos", 2]),
    slope_adj = slope_a,
    ci_low_adj = ci_a_lo,
    ci_high_adj = ci_a_hi
  )
})

grad <- bind_rows(grad_rows)
write_csv(grad, grad_csv)
writeLines(
  sprintf("Spearman(median_UMI, chain position) = %.3f%s",
          rho_umi,
          if (is.finite(rho_umi) && abs(rho_umi) > 0.5)
            " — **|ρ|>0.5: gradient and detection power are confounded; adjusted model is doing heavy lifting.**"
          else ""),
  file.path(tbl_dir, "VR3_umi_position_correlation.txt")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-fig-node
#| eval: !expr run_analysis
#| fig-show: hide

node <- relay_hits %>%
  group_by(pos = chain_position) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    k = sum(direction == "WildR-UP"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    est = wilson_ci(k, n)["est"],
    low = wilson_ci(k, n)["low"],
    high = wilson_ci(k, n)["high"]
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pos_num = as.integer(pos))

p <- ggplot(node, aes(pos_num, est)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), colour = "#FF6C0C", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(colour = "#FF6C0C", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "WildR-UP fraction by chain position",
    x = "Chain position (1–4; 3G excluded)",
    y = "WildR-UP fraction (Wilson 95% CI)"
  ) +
  vr_brand_ggplot()
ggsave(node_png, p, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
write_csv(node, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR3_node_fractions.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-audit
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

mmc <- read_csv(paths$mapmycells, show_col_types = FALSE, comment = "#")
meta_sp <- readRDS(paths$spatial_meta) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "cell_id") %>%
  mutate(cell_id = as.character(cell_id))

# Identify name columns
name_col <- grep("supertype_name", names(mmc), value = TRUE)[1]
id_col <- names(mmc)[1]
mmc2 <- mmc %>%
  rename(cell_id = !!id_col) %>%
  mutate(cell_id = as.character(cell_id))

if (!is.na(name_col)) {
  joined <- meta_sp %>%
    inner_join(mmc2 %>% select(cell_id, supertype_name = !!name_col), by = "cell_id")
} else {
  joined <- meta_sp %>% mutate(supertype_name = NA_character_)
}

# Placement: MeA / COAp labelled cells — without full CCF polygon join, report
# coordinate summaries and flag need for Allen_CCF_rebuild join
mea <- joined %>% filter(grepl("MEA|COAp|0055 |0056 |0057 |0058 |0059 ",
                               coalesce(supertype_name, "")))
hippo <- joined %>% filter(grepl("CA3|DG Glut|0076 |Hippocamp",
                                 coalesce(supertype_name, "")))

# Approximate AMY sections: rois historically labelled for amygdala blocks
amy_like <- joined %>% filter(TRUE) # all cells in spatial object are ROI sections
n_amy <- nrow(joined)
n_hippo <- nrow(hippo)
hippo_frac <- n_hippo / max(n_amy, 1)

lines <- c(
  "# VR-3 dissection audit",
  "",
  sprintf("- Spatial reference: MapMyCells Allen CCN20230722 joined to seqFISH metadata (`merged_roi_seurat_metadata_2024-07-15.rds`)."),
  sprintf("- Cells with MeA/COAp-like supertype labels: %d.", nrow(mea)),
  sprintf("- Hippocampal-labelled cells (CA3/DG/0076-like): %d (%.2f%% of mapped spatial nuclei).",
          n_hippo, 100 * hippo_frac),
  "- **Note:** Precise MeA/COAp boundary placement requires joining `Allen_CCF_rebuild` polygons **within section**; until that join is complete, treat placement accuracy as pending and report hippocampal %% as the carry-over audit number.",
  sprintf("- `0076 CA3 Glut 2` is excluded from relay interpretation; hippocampal fraction above validates carry-over quantitatively."),
  ""
)
write_md(audit_md, lines)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-meapd
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

# Within-section dorsal/ventral partition for MeA-labelled cells
mea_cells <- joined %>%
  filter(grepl("MEA Slc17a7|0055 |0056 |0057 |MEA-COA", coalesce(supertype_name, ""))) %>%
  group_by(roi, bregma) %>%
  mutate(
    # within-section: above median y = dorsal (verify axis orientation against markers)
    y_med = median(center_y, na.rm = TRUE),
    compartment = if_else(center_y >= y_med, "MeApd_proxy", "MeApv_proxy")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Marker agreement: Esr1, Cckar, Ndnf if on panel — score via spatial object when run
# Placeholder agreement using coordinate partition only until gene panel scored
marker_agreement <- NA_real_

# Signature genes from VR-1 if available, else expected core on panel
sig_path <- file.path(wkdir, "tables/VR/VR1/VR1_signature_genes.json")
sig_genes <- if (file.exists(sig_path)) {
  jsonlite::fromJSON(sig_path)$genes_pos
} else {
  c("Eps8l1", "Zbtb16", "Hdac9", "Trpm3", "Rasa1")
}

# Without loading 4.4GB spatial Seurat here, write ratio scaffold from cell counts
# and instruct full expression map when run_analysis loads the object.
ratios <- mea_cells %>%
  mutate(
    animal = as.character(group), # seqFISH group encodes animal/condition in this study
    microbiome = case_when(
      grepl("WildR|wild", group, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "WildR",
      grepl("SPF|spf", group, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "SPF",
      TRUE ~ as.character(group)
    )
  ) %>%
  count(animal, microbiome, roi, compartment, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(animal, microbiome, roi) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), frac = n / total) %>%
  ungroup()

# Per-animal dorsal/ventral ratio
dv <- ratios %>%
  select(animal, microbiome, roi, compartment, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = compartment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_d_v = MeApd_proxy / pmax(MeApv_proxy, 1),
    n_cells = MeApd_proxy + MeApv_proxy,
    flag_low_n = n_cells < 50
  )

# Aggregate to animal (mean across sections)
dv_animal <- dv %>%
  group_by(animal, microbiome) %>%
  summarise(
    ratio = mean(ratio_d_v, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cells = sum(n_cells),
    n_sections = n(),
    any_low_n = any(flag_low_n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cd <- tryCatch(
  cliffs_delta(
    dv_animal$ratio[dv_animal$microbiome == "WildR"],
    dv_animal$ratio[dv_animal$microbiome == "SPF"]
  ),
  error = function(e) list(delta = NA, ci_low = NA, ci_high = NA)
)

write_csv(dv, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR3_meapd_section_counts.csv"))
write_csv(dv_animal, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR3_meapd_animal_ratios.csv"))

lines <- c(
  "# VR-3 MeApd vs MeApv test",
  "",
  "- Partition: **within section** (roi × bregma), dorsal = center_y ≥ section median. Axis orientation must be cross-checked against `Esr1` / `Cckar` / `Ndnf` when scored on the spatial panel.",
  sprintf("- Marker–coordinate agreement rate: %s (pending gene scoring on spatial object).", as.character(marker_agreement)),
  sprintf("- Signature genes requested: %s.", paste(sig_genes, collapse = ", ")),
  sprintf("- Cliff's δ (WildR vs SPF on per-animal dorsal/ventral ratio): **%.3f** (CI %.3f – %.3f).",
          cd$delta %||% NA_real_, cd$ci_low %||% NA_real_, cd$ci_high %||% NA_real_),
  "- Animals with any section <50 MeA cells are flagged in `VR3_meapd_animal_ratios.csv`.",
  "- Expression map (`VR3_meapd_map.png`) requires loading `merged_roi_seurat_prenorm_2026-02-16.rds` and scoring available signature genes on panel; see `cell-fig-meapd`.",
  ""
)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a) && length(a) && !is.na(a[1])) a else b
write_md(meapd_md, lines)
```
